weapon.d: Grants Atk+3. If the number of flying units on team ≥ 3 and unit initiates combat, inflicts Atk/Def-4 on foe during combat and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack. If the number of flying allies within 2 spaces ≥ 2 and unit initiates combat, unit attacks twice.

assist.d: Target ally moves to opposite side of unit.

a.d: If unit initiates combat, grants Res+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk/Res+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk/Res+4 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk+6, Res+10 during combat and foe cannot make a follow-up attack.

b.d: At start of turn, inflicts Atk-3 on foe on the enemy team with the highest Atk through its next action.
At start of turn, inflicts Atk/Spd-3 on foe on the enemy team with the highest Atk+Spd total through its next action.
At start of turn, inflicts Atk/Spd-5 on foe on the enemy team with the highest Atk+Spd total through its next action.

c.d: Grants Atk+2 to adjacent allies during combat.
Grants Atk+3 to adjacent allies during combat.
Grants Atk/Spd+4 to flying allies within 2 spaces during combat.
